title: Fourier coefficients of a subspace restriction
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $H\le V$, let $f:V\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $\phi$ be a linear functional on $H$. The Fourier coefficient of the restriction of $f$ to $H$ at $\phi$ equals the sum of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ at all linear functionals on $V$ whose restrictions to $H$ equal $\phi$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and a vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$
